faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Guest Faculty Teacher posts is 30-08-2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty Teacher position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies for the Guest Faculty Teacher position across various subjects as per the notification released by Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for PGT posts?
faq.answer: For PGT posts, candidates must possess a Master's Degree in the relevant subject along with a B.Ed. degree from an NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for TGT posts?
faq.answer: TGT posts require a Bachelor's Degree in the relevant subject with B.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks, and candidates must also be TET qualified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty Teacher posts is 50 years. There is no mention of age relaxation in the provided data.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty Teacher positions ranges from Rs. 34125 to Rs. 36000 per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on the weightage given to qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interaction with the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process for the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Guest Faculty Teacher posts is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
